title: Martin Cannon's The Controllers and John Alexander's threat
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Martin Cannon's The Controllers and John Alexander's threat, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean there's a book called um the controllers by a guy name I think Martin Cannon and apparently John Alexander like threatened him when he wrote this book
it's basically about this idea of the the fabrication of alien abductions,
tellings.difference: Describes the book's thesis on fabricated abductions and leaves out John Alexander's threat.
tellings.link_reason: Same book, Martin Cannon's The Controllers; this telling gives its thesis that alien abductions were fabricated.
